title: Before the Long Trip
logline: A fishing family spends the day before a multi-day trip securing the house, settling debts, and telling neighbours exactly when to expect the boat back, so that being unreachable for days does not mean being irresponsible.

object.note: Object 10 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: Readiness for the sea becomes preparation for leaving it for a while: a fishing family settling everything before days out of reach.

thread_out.thread: Stepping away without abandoning anyone leads to a final giving away: an elderly woman emptying a house of sixty years, and a doorway that becomes Chathura's road toward the crowd.

requirements: A fishing family with a real multi-day trip during the filming window
Consent to film both departure preparations and, if possible, the return
No filming of the trip itself unless it can be done safely

suggestions.name: Kalpitiya
suggestions.why: A well-known base for multi-day deep-sea fishing trips.
suggestions.verify: A specific willing family and trip must be identified.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed.
